name: Screen reader mode
summary: A plain, linear text view of Claude Code built for screen readers.
what: Screen reader mode replaces the visual terminal interface with labeled text that VoiceOver, NVDA and similar tools read well. There are also options for magnifiers, reduced motion and colorblind-friendly themes.

impact.title: Clear diffs
impact.detail: Changes are read as plain text.

impact.title: Audible cues
impact.detail: A bell tells you when Claude needs you.

howItWorks: Start with claude --ax-screen-reader, or set CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1.
Or set axScreenReader to true in your user settings.
Pick the dark-daltonized or light-daltonized theme for colorblind-friendly colors.
